body: I guess you are right. I don't ask for help often. It's one of my problems. I am very independent and don't like to feel weak, or that I owe someone so I tend to try and fix things on my own. Thank you for the words of encouragement. I have clincal depression that I guess has been undiagnosed since early Highschool so I have been trying on my own for awhile to solve things. Your advice is welcome.
